function.name: find_beer
function.description: Recommend a beer based on specified attributes such as name, brewery, taste, aroma, color, style, and more. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

beer_name.description: The name of the beer to search for.

brewery.description: The brewery name to find similar beers.

taste.description: The desired taste profile in the beer, such as 'bitter', 'sweet', 'sour'.

aroma.description: The desired aroma profile in the beer, such as 'fruity', 'hoppy', 'malty'.

color.description: The desired color of the beer, such as 'pale', 'amber', 'dark'.

style.description: The style of beer being searched for, such as 'IPA', 'stout', 'lager'.

abv_min.description: The minimum alcohol by volume (ABV) percentage, typically a value under 12.5%. This is a float type value.

abv_max.description: The maximum alcohol by volume (ABV) percentage, a value logically above 0%. This is a float type value.

ibu_min.description: The minimum International Bitterness Units (IBU) score, typically a value under 120.

ibu_max.description: The maximum International Bitterness Units (IBU) score, logically above 0.

pairings.description: A list of food items to pair with the beer, such as 'burger', 'cheese', 'chocolate'.

message.content:
Sure thing! When it comes to balancing the savory, spicy crunch of Korean‑fried chicken, you’ll want a dessert that’s both refreshing and slightly sweet—something that cleanses the palate without overpowering the flavors already on your plate. Here are three crowd‑pleasing choices: | Dessert | Why It Works | Pairing Tips | |---------|--------------|-------------| | **Mango Sticky Rice** (Khao Niew Ma Muang) | • Sweet, ripe mango contrasts nicely with salty, crispy skin.
• Coconut milk adds creamy richness while keeping things light.| Serve chilled; drizzle extra coconut sauce over the top. If you’re feeling adventurous, add a pinch of sea salt to accentuate the contrast. | | **Fresh Fruit Salad + Honey Lime Dressing** | • Bright citrus notes cut through the oiliness of the chicken.
• Light honey glaze gives subtle sweetness without heaviness.| Mix seasonal fruits (pineapple, kiwi, berries). Finish with lime zest and a splash of agave syrup. | | **Chocolate Mousse with Chili & Sea Salt** | • Dark chocolate’s bitterness balances spice; chili adds heat echoing the chicken's kick.
• Sea salt enhances all flavors.| Chill well before serving. Sprinkle finely grated dark chocolate or cacao nibs on top for texture. | ### Quick “Dessert-on-the-Go” Option If you’d rather keep it simple, grab an ice cream scoop of vanilla bean or salted caramel. Scoop into a small bowl, then sprinkle crushed pistachios or toasted sesame seeds for a nutty finish that echoes Asian flavor profiles. --- #### How to Decide: 1. **Sweetness Level:** Mango sticky rice → very sweet; fruit salad → moderate; chocolate mousse → deep, bittersweet. 2. **Texture Preference:** Want crunchy? Add nuts or granola to the fruit salad. Prefer silky? Go with mousse or ice cream. 3. **Time Constraints:** All three take less than 10 minutes if ingredients are prepped ahead. Enjoy your meal—and remember, the best dessert is one that leaves you refreshed enough to savor another bite of those golden wings!
